hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE -- "(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*condor_(submit|rm)\b|^[[:space:]]*law[[:space:]]+run\b.*--allow-submission" && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This command submits or removes HTCondor batch jobs. Confirm before running."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // ""' | { read -r f; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/vols/cms/dw515/WorkflowAutomation}"; case "$f" in ""|"$root"|"$root"/*) ;; *) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This writes outside the project working tree. Confirm before changing files elsewhere."}}' ;; esac; }
